messages:
pagerduty: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: INC-987654 triggered -> High 5xx error rate detected for service inference-gateway-usw2. alert: error_rate(5xx) > 2% (1m). Notifying oncall rotation.

oncall-bot: auto-pager fired to @jasper, @lin. Incident link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/INC-987654 (details + runbook).

jasper: ack. I'm on it. seeing a sharp spike starting ~23:04 UTC. majority 502/503s on POST /v1/infer. no deploy in last 40m.

lin: ack. pulling logs and metrics now. can someone confirm LB pool health and KV cache stats?

rachel: LB shows all backends healthy at LB layer, but one host model-node-14 has CPU at 92% and frequent GC spikes.

jasper: logs show kv cache lookup timeouts and a lot of fall-throughs to model nodes. snippet:
```
ERROR inference-kvcache: lookup timeout after 250ms, key=conv-abc123
WARN request-fallback: falling back to model node
500 POST /v1/infer 10.2.3.4 "-" 8.9ms
```

lin: metrics: global 5xx = 2.7%. region usw2-east-az-b = 9.1%. p95 latency hasn't moved much (~180ms) which suggests backend overload rather than slow network. kvcache_eviction_rate spiked 10x at 23:03.

jasper: hypothesis: a short TTL change earlier caused an eviction storm -> thundering cache misses -> model nodes overloaded -> 5xx. mitigation ideas:
- increase KV cache TTLs temporarily (roll back recent TTL tweak)
- scale model pool by +2 replicas in usw2 region
- remove canary routing so traffic hits stable variant
- reroute traffic off the noisy AZ if needed

rachel: scaling up model replicas (+2) now via infra autoscale. also can pin to quantized-stable to reduce CPU.

oncall-bot: scaling job started: jobs/scale-models-1716112222 (expected add 2 replicas).

pagerduty: INC-987654 acknowledged by jasper.

lin: while scale kicks in, I'm bumping nginx keepalive from 15s -> 30s in the edge to reduce connection churn (one-liner):
```
keepalive_timeout 30s;
```

jasper: after scale actions, 5xx dropped to ~1.1% within 4 minutes. still seeing transient spikes on cold-start traffic. beginning a controlled rollback of the recent kv TTL change (revert commit d4f2b9).

rachel: rollback applied to caching service and confirmed. model nodes stable and CPU falling to 45-55%. healthchecks green.

sre-rotation: taking over for the next 30m to stabilize and follow runbook. jasper handing off. jasper - can you add notes to the incident doc before you go?

jasper: added notes: suspected root cause = aggressive TTL tuning in prior release + single model node GC/CPU hotspot. capturing histograms + eviction traces in incident doc. leaving for postmortem.

customer-success-bot: CS notified: no active customer P1 reports yet. CS will monitor and escalate if customers report degraded UX.

lin: marking condition as mitigated in PD after observing sustained drop below alert threshold for 10m. leaving a few followups: add alert for kvcache_eviction_rate and add cache circuit-breaker to avoid fallback storm.

pagerduty: INC-987654 status changed to: Mitigated. :white_check_mark:

rachel: filing follow-up ticket to add eviction-rate alert and a playback test to the CI to avoid TTL regressions.

sre-rotation: thanks all. handoff complete. I'll coordinate the postmortem and include remediation (circuit-breaker, safer TTL rollout, AZ routing policy).

jasper: +1. Good run. :thumbsup:
